text:
Jordan (AE): Quick handoff for TheraCore — contract signed, preferred deployment: Dedicated (reserved) with optional Private/VPC later. Key asks: SAML SSO, HIPAA data residency in us-east-1, and a short enablement session for clinicians. Renewal aligns with their fiscal Q4; they flagged procurement lead time as a renewal risk. Need CS owner + triage plan to get staging up within 7 business days.

Nina (CSM): I can take this. What do we have for infra? Customer contact is ellie@theracore.ai, aws acct 555666777888. Ellie expects initial demo next Fri. I'll prepare enablement deck and a prompt-evaluation checklist.

Ravi (SE): Rapid notes: I spun up a test node in dedicated-useast1. We need their SAML metadata and their VPC CIDR for peering. Also recommend quantized model variant for cost during pilots. I'll attach model size/ram matrix in the ticket.

Omar (Support): Creating infra ticket now — <https://redwood.example.com/tickets/6230|ticket-6230>. Tags: theracore, hipaa, dedicated. Assigning to Ravi and infra-team. ETA triage 6h. ops-bot will post status updates here. :mag: 

Jordan (AE): Procurement timeline note: legal wants a signed DPA before any PII ingestion. They asked about audit logs retention and KMS integration. Nina — pls add to enablement scope and confirm DPA status.

Nina (CSM): Good call. I'll check DPA status with Sales Legal and add a slide on KMS + logging. Also capturing action owners: Nina = CSM/onboarding; Ravi = infra & model ops; Omar = support triage; Jordan = sales escalation and DPA follow-up.

Ravi (SE): Customer-side snippet they can apply to establish peering:

```
# Add route for Redwood peering
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc1234 --destination-cidr-block 10.50.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0f1e2d3c4b
```

Ravi (SE): I'll drop the exact SG rules and EFS mount instructions into ticket-6230. Also recommending we enable prefix KV caching for their clinician flows to save tokens.

ops-bot: ticket-6230 status: created -> triage_pending. Next update expected in ~4h.

Omar (Support): Linking onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/theracore. I'll mark the ticket as blocker for the demo until peering is validated. Once peering validated, I'll schedule a smoke test with Ravi. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (AE): Procurement: Ellie said procurement will prioritize once DPA is in place. Renewal risk: if integration slips >30 days, they may trial a competitor. Tagging account as renewal_watch.

Nina (CSM): I'll add renewal_watch in CRM and collect clinician use-cases before enablement. Post-demo: we'll run a short survey and surface any model quality concerns to Research. Also will review Redwood Optimize options (batching + quantization) in the session.

Ravi (SE): Action items: 1) Upload SG + route snippets to ticket-6230 (me). 2) Post-peering smoke test (Ravi + Omar). 3) Enablement deck & invite (Nina). 4) DPA follow-up (Jordan). I'll update ticket when staging confirms connectivity.

Omar (Support): Will update here once we validate peering. If anything blocks, paging infra-oncall.

Nina (CSM): I'll send calendar invite for Fri demo after we get ticket-6230 "peering_validated" state. Thanks all — ping if anything changes.
